title: Agentic QA
subtitle: Shipping fast and in volume without shipping what a token predictor writes
description: A short expert guide to using language-model agents for software QA. It derives its operating rules from how the models actually work — next-token sampling, length-rewarded training, self-agreement — and from the arithmetic of verification, and it names the failure that dominates agent-written test suites: tests that assert the mock.
